Price of a kWh of heat in a window's objective

Source: R/tank_optimization.R
tank_heat_price.Rd

The highest marginal value a kW of electric load can take in the window's objective, divided by the lowest positive COP (when below 1): no kWh of compressor heat is worth more than it. For "cost" the marginal value is the highest absolute import or (clipped) export price; for "grid" the derivative of the squared net flow at its largest, 2 * (max|L - G| + Pc + Pb); a weight w mixes both as the objective does, and a ramping penalty adds its largest derivative 4 * lambda * Pc.

Usage

tank_heat_price(L, G, cop, Pc, Pb, objective, lambda, price, scale)

Arguments

L

numeric vector, static load (kW)

G

numeric vector, production (kW)

cop

numeric vector, coefficient of performance

Pc

numeric, compressor cap (kW)

Pb

numeric, backup heater cap (kW); 0 means no backup heater

objective

"grid", "cost" or a number strictly between 0 and 1

lambda

numeric, ramping penalty weight

price

numeric, highest absolute electricity price of the window

scale

numeric, the weighted objective's price scale

Value

positive number, in the objective's units per kW of heat and slot
